body: AI Studio GenAI token consumption spiked above 100k tokens / 5m. Possible runaway agent loop or abuse. Inspect the run in Langfuse (lf.octodemo.cloud) and agent fan-out in OCI APM.
resolveBody: AI Studio GenAI token rate is back to normal.
